# ACTA Gate

> Any Soroban contract can require a valid verifiable credential, with revocation applied live.

ACTA Gate was built at HackMeridian 2026 (Scale track) on top of ACTA's vault contracts
(`vc-vault`, `vc-vault-factory`, `did-stellar-registry`), which are already on Stellar mainnet.
It turns a credential stored in an ACTA vault into something a contract can check: a treasury
that only pays credentialed contributors, a vote only credentialed members can take part in.
One credential opens both; one revocation by the issuer closes both. Nobody maintains an
allowlist.

## The demo

GrantFox, a Stellar contributor platform piloting ACTA credentials, has a USDC treasury that
only pays holders of a valid "Contributor Gold" credential. Marta is a contributor (demo
persona). The visitor plays all three roles: Marta creates a passkey wallet (ACTA registers her
`did:stellar` and deploys her vault, she signs nothing and needs no XLM), GrantFox issues the
credential into her vault and registers it in `vc-gate`, the treasury pays her, the treasury
fails to pay an address without a credential, GrantFox revokes the credential in her vault and
the next payment to Marta is rejected. Every click is a real Stellar testnet transaction.

## Contracts (Stellar testnet, passphrase `Test SDF Network ; September 2015`)

- `vc-vault-factory` (vault template 0.5.0): CCHI33MJAWFCLHLX6CLFAT32ERHMILF3LCUV4SYKWP3ASIBTPZNRDL3Y
- `vc-gate`: CCQLGN7IOR4GSGDLLQ2SALMUWWQ67DGHV7WQUEDZDGTFIX3OIKA5HOU2
- `credential-policy`: CAI3YAVSWX2GA5SX2KCAMHLOLHVOPZUL2MXQQNSIUFSRY2RBKKOJGIQR
- GrantFox treasury (OpenZeppelin smart account): CD724INVERFLPXAULVMTMUUUEKLWF2YIGIJ7MC2J3XBYU35F3IAZ64NP
- `credential-vote`: implemented and tested, not deployed yet

## Pieces

- `vc-gate`: an index for contracts, from an address to its credential and public claims. Re-reads the vault on every query, so revocation is never cached. No admin, no upgrade path.
- `credential-policy`: an OpenZeppelin smart-account `Policy`. Installed on a treasury, it only lets it pay credentialed addresses. Rejects an empty signer set, opens `execute` to check the inner `transfer`, rejects `approve`.
- `credential-vote`: a plain contract where only credentialed addresses propose and vote. The second consumer of `vc-gate`.
- `vc-vault` (modified ACTA contract, 0.5.0): records who issued each credential and lets the issuer revoke it (`revoke_by_issuer`), plus `is_revoked()`.
- `apps/api`: sponsors the holder's DID and vault, issues and registers credentials, signs treasury payments.
- `apps/web`: the demo console at https://gate.acta.build.

## Stack

Soroban (`soroban-sdk` 26.1), OpenZeppelin `stellar-accounts` 0.7.2 and `smart-account-kit` (passkeys), Next.js 16, Express 5, pnpm and Turborepo.
